from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion


class EquityDonchianBreakoutTurtleAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)

        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        self._spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE).symbol
        # Session-based price bands, traded only while the session runs.
        self._session_high = SessionHigh(self._spy, 9, 30, 10, 0)
        self._session_low = SessionLow(self._spy, 9, 30, 10, 0)
        # Donchian breakouts on the intraday session range.
        self._donchian = Donchian(20, 20)
        # Track the most recent session close so we can act when price reverts to the middle.
        self._previous_session_close = 0
        # Stop trading the pair once the market opens at 10 AM.
        self._trading = True
        # Long if price breaks above the session high, short if it breaks below the session low.
        self._long_threshold = 0.01
        self._short_threshold = -0.01

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day(self._spy),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._spy, 9, 30),
            self._rebalance
        )

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        if not self._trading:
            return
        # Session-based universe filter: only trade while the session is running.
        if not self._session_high.is_ready or not self._session_low.is_ready:
            return
        # Donchian-based signal: trade when price breaks the session high/low.
        donchian_upper = self._donchian.upper_band
        donchian_lower = self._donchian.lower_band
        price = self.securities[self._spy].price
        if not self.portfolio.invested and price > donchian_upper + self._long_threshold:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy, 1.0)
        elif not self.portfolio.invested and price < donchian_lower - self._short_threshold:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy, -1.0)
        elif self.portfolio.invested:
            self.liquidate(self._spy)

    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent) -> None:
        if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:
            self.plot("Fills", "SPY", order_event.fill_price * order_event.fill_quantity)
